app.title: DnD Battlemap
app.subtitle: Offline battle maps for D&D 5e
nav.label: Main navigation
start.heading: No map open
start.intro: Build maps from elements, import your own images, place creatures and show areas of effect square by square – entirely without internet.
start.status: Development status: phase 4 (image import with grid calibration, edge walls). Tokens, effects and combat features follow.
start.offline: This application makes no network connections.
toolbar.label: Toolbar

ruler.hintMouse: Drag to measure · Space: waypoint · Esc: clear

align.heading: Align
layers.heading: Layers
layers.name: Layer
terrain.heading: Terrain
terrain.hint: Apply with brush, rectangle, line or fill; the eraser removes painted terrain. Elements bring their own defaults (e.g. walls block).
note.heading: GM note – square {x}, {y}
note.hint: Visible to the GM only. Ctrl+Enter saves.
generator.heading: Insert template or random dungeon
generator.tooBig: The template is larger than the map. Enlarge the map or choose a smaller size.
generator.replace: Replace existing content in the area
notice.fillObjects: Fill only works with floors or terrain.
notice.outside: That does not fit on the map.
notice.chooseElement: Please choose an element on the left first.
hint.select: Click: select · Shift: add · Drag: move or draw a frame · Arrow keys: move selection
hint.brush: Drag to paint · Q rotates the element
hint.shape: Drag from corner to corner · keyboard: Enter at start and end
hint.fill: Click fills connected squares with the same floor
hint.erase: Drag removes content of the active layer (or terrain)
hint.note: Click a square to write or edit a GM note
shortcut.tools: Tools: select, brush, rectangle, line, fill, eraser, note
imageImport.filterName: Map images (JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, GIF)
imageImport.badType: Only JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP or GIF can be imported as a map.
imageImport.tooLarge: The image file is larger than 200 MB.
imageImport.badContent: The file content does not match its extension or is not an image.
imageImport.tooManyPixels: The image is too large (at most 16384 pixels per side).
imageImport.decodeFailed: The image could not be decoded.
imageImport.dropHint: Drop a map image or .dndmap file here
calibrate.headingNew: New map from image – calibrate grid
calibrate.heading: Calibrate background image
calibrate.canvasLabel: Image preview. Drag or arrow keys move the grid (Shift: 10 px), wheel or +/− zooms, 0 fits, right mouse button pans.
calibrate.hintMove: Drag: move grid · Wheel: zoom · Right button: pan · yellow = square 1, 1
calibrate.hintPoints: Click two points on grid lines or intersections, then enter the number of squares between them
calibrate.detected: Detected: {px} px per square (clarity {percent} %). Please check.
calibrate.detectNone: No grid detected – please set the square size manually or with two points.
calibrate.pointsInvalid: The points are too close or the number of squares is invalid.
calibrate.tooManyCells: More than 200 squares – the map is limited to 200 and the rest of the image is hidden. Check crop or square size.
calibrate.fewCells: Fewer than 10 squares – maps have at least 10 × 10 squares; outside the image they stay empty.
calibrate.fitGrid: Fit map size to the image
hint.wall: Click sets corner points (chain) · Double-click, right button or Esc ends · keyboard: Enter at the top-left square corner
